text:
Beginning: Sophia, an aspiring musician, struggles with severe stage fright that prevents her from performing her music publicly.

Climax: Inspired by encounters with seasoned artists, Sophia faces her fears at a major music festival, delivering a powerful performance that resonates deeply with the audience.

Resolution: Her successful performance marks the beginning of her rising career, as she overcomes her stage fright and shares her talents with the world.

The transparent material used to make windows is glass.
